page.layout: One printed page: title page. Centred lines from top to bottom, then a woodcut engraving of a figure with a harp in the middle, then the imprint at the foot.
page.notes: The woodcut engraving in the middle shows a bearded figure with flowing hair, holding a harp in the raised right hand and a pipe or horn in the left, standing on a rocky shore with waves and a sea creature at the feet. Not transcribed as text. The page number "1" in handwriting at the top right corner and the smudged stamp at the top left are not printed text and are left out. The "M. D. LXXXII." is printed with its stops as they appear. Line-end hyphens ("HABA-", "PRO-", "re-", "A-", "OPORI-") are printed and kept. The word "Basilien si" is printed with a space as it appears on the scan, possibly a printing or scan artefact; "Basiliensi" is the expected word, so this is marked for checking.
